purpose: Revision 4 changes on top of the v1 tables (configs/internet-lng-v1-ko.json and configs/internet-ui-v1-ko.json stay unchanged so v1-v3 rebuild byte-identically).
lng_keep_english_reason: These four entries are only referenced by the software keyboard's input-field hint (executable 0x8005451c/0x800545dc/0x8005459c/0x8005455c, keyboard types URL/message/password/search). The keyboard loads only the 'wii_name' glyph group of wbf1 (string at 0x8088ddd8); in the Korean 43K font that group holds 8 sheets with 1 Hangul sheet, while the hint syllables sit on sheets 38, 41-45 and 48 of the 50-sheet 'ksx_hangul' group, so Hangul draws as '?'.
local_thumbnails_reason: Local build only: the first-run import pairs the files.dat thumbnails with favorites by order, so the test entries showed the Yahoo!/Google/Recommended Sites pictures. The hardware candidate keeps the original thumbnails.
